indicator_name: GDP deflator by production approach, by ОКЭД section, year-to-date
description: Дефлятор ВВП методом производства, по видам экономической деятельности, нарастающим итогом с начала года
unit: % of the same period of the previous year, year-to-date
methodology: Year-to-date columns of the 2010–present sheet; 2010 Q1 – 2026 H1 on 2026-09-23. Same rows as GVA_DEFLATOR_BY_SECTION.
transformation: as published: the year-to-date period (January-March, January-June, January-September, the year) in % of the same period of the previous year -- not converted to discrete quarters
